## Here's to the crazy ones

1. The misfits.
2. The rebels.
3. The troublemakers.
   - The round pegs in the square holes.

**The ones who see things differently.**

They're not fond of rules.

And they have no respect for the status quo.

## Because they change things

You can ==quote== them, =={pink}disagree== with them, =={orange}glorify== or =={blue}vilify== them. While some may see them as ~~the crazy ones~~, we see =={mint}genius==. About the only thing you can't do is *ignore* them.

They push the human race forward. See the [campaign history](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Think_different).

> Because the people who are crazy enough to think they can change the world, are the ones who do.

### What you can't do

- [ ] Ignore them
- [x] Quote them

```
Think different.
Apple, 1997
```

| Some see | We see |
| --- | --- |
| the crazy ones | genius |
